user.title: Connect BoardGameGeek
user.description: Enter your BGG username. Since 2025 BGG requires an API token (bearer) for the XML API.

data.include_expansions: Sync expansions and link them to base games
data.bgg_password: BGG password (only for logging plays on BGG)
data.upload_plays: Automatically log finished and manually added plays on BGG

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Starts a sync with BoardGameGeek immediately.

get_games.name: Get games
get_games.description: Returns the stored games and expansions including language of the selected version and links.

language.name: Language
language.description: Only games whose selected version has this language (BGG name, e.g. German).

type.name: Type
type.description: all = games and expansions, games = base games only, expansions = expansions only.

set_game_meta.name: Set game assignment
set_game_meta.description: Assigns location, NFC tag, Spotify playlist and light profile to a game.

bgg_id.name: BGG ID
bgg_id.description: BGG ID of the game (alternative to name).

name.name: Name
name.description: Game name (a unique part is enough).

location.name: Location
location.description: Where the game is stored, e.g. "Shelf 2, slot 3". Empty = clear.

nfc_tag.name: NFC tag
nfc_tag.description: Tag ID from Settings → Tags. Empty = clear.

spotify_uri.name: Spotify playlist
spotify_uri.description: Spotify link or URI. Empty = clear.

light_scene.name: Light profile
light_scene.description: Scene or script activated when a game starts. Empty = clear.

assign_scanned_tag.name: Assign scanned tag
assign_scanned_tag.description: Assigns the most recently scanned NFC tag (last 10 min) to the game.

bgg_id.name: BGG ID
bgg_id.description: BGG ID of the game (alternative to name).

name.name: Name
name.description: Game name (a unique part is enough).

start_play.name: Start play
start_play.description: Starts logging; without a game the accepted suggestion is used. Activates light and playlist.

bgg_id.name: BGG ID
bgg_id.description: BGG ID of the game (alternative to name).

name.name: Name
name.description: Game name (a unique part is enough).

end_play.name: End play
end_play.description: Ends the running play and stores its duration.

upload_to_bgg.name: Log on BGG
upload_to_bgg.description: Also log the play on BGG (default: setting in the options). Requires the BGG password.

cancel_play.name: Cancel play
cancel_play.description: Discards the running play without logging it.

log_play.name: Log play
log_play.description: Manually logs a play that already happened.

bgg_id.name: BGG ID
bgg_id.description: BGG ID of the game (alternative to name).

name.name: Name
name.description: Game name (a unique part is enough).

upload_to_bgg.name: Log on BGG
upload_to_bgg.description: Also log the play on BGG (default: setting in the options). Requires the BGG password.

upload_play.name: Log play on BGG
upload_play.description: Uploads a locally stored play to BGG, e.g. after a failed upload. Requires the BGG password in the options.

play_id.name: Play ID
play_id.description: Local ID of the play (field id from get_plays).

get_plays.name: Get plays
get_plays.description: Returns stored plays (optionally for one game).

bgg_id.name: BGG ID
bgg_id.description: BGG ID of the game (alternative to name).

name.name: Name
name.description: Game name (a unique part is enough).

suggest_game.name: Suggest game
suggest_game.description: Randomly suggests a matching game from the collection.

game_type.name: Game type
game_type.description: any, family, strategy, party, abstract, thematic, wargame or children.

max_playtime.name: Max. duration (minutes)
max_playtime.description: Only games up to this playing time.
